activity_summary: You rehearsed The Comedy of Errors with Phillips, Cowley and Pope. The hat was on the wrong peg and fell when the door stuck. Phillips set the entrance at twelve paces from the property-chest, and Cowley came in on "anon." You told them to let the hat fall at two, if it fell, and go on. The bill is two of the clock.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Told them to leave the hat, take the cue, and eat before two.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Set the entrance at twelve paces and the cue on "anon," and kept the peg for himself at the half hour.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Took the cue, and said he would walk the twelve paces once in the yard.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Claimed the hat, got out of the doorway, and stayed for cold meat in the tiring-house.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in A hat on the wrong peg

facets.activity: Told them to let the hat fall and go on

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Two of the clock. The rest of it has been played before, and it can be played again.
